content.short: The aim of this website is to educate people about Cardano blockchain technology using short documentary videos.
content.description:
We do interviews with people who are using this technology in real-life. We filmed Blockchain Class - a 30-minute educational programme for newcomers. We are behind a documentary about Wada - Chasing the Wada Dream. We focus on Cardano4Climate and Project Catalyst. In November 2022 we filmed at Cardano Summit in Switzerland.

We are open to cooperation with other Cardano communities to showcase the achievements and the future possibilities. Our tool is film and media.

Do you want to share our work / are you looking for a filmmaker for your project? Send me a message to petr@vivatscreen.com
